records.operation: Trace the four coin silhouettes and their cutout symbols from the perspective-corrected card photograph.

Trace the worm, pool ripples and engraved basin with subpixel smoothing. Preserve narrow light contours around the mouth, and remove the false notch in the left frame. The pale pool and engravings remain transparent cutouts.

Reconstruct the measured star edges and eight large triangular cutouts as straight paths. Restore the bold circular rim and eight small ray openings. Use concentric circles for the central ring and upper-right ring glyph; retain the other traced glyphs. The faint outer circle and long radial guides belong to the card background and remain omitted.
records.cutoutIsolation: Manually reconstruct eight large triangles and eight small openings from both references. Render only the exposed circular rim arcs, so the rim cannot fill a glyph cutout.
